psychological_meaning: Purple is often associated with royalty, luxury, and sophistication. It can also represent creativity, wisdom, dignity, and independence. In some contexts, purple can evoke feelings of mystery, spirituality, and magic, but overuse can sometimes lead to feelings of artificiality or moodiness.

real_world_examples.title: Cadbury Chocolate
real_world_examples.description: The iconic purple packaging of Cadbury chocolate is instantly recognizable and associated with quality and indulgence.

real_world_examples.title: Royal Robes
real_world_examples.description: Historically, purple dye was expensive and rare, making it a color associated with royalty and power, as seen in royal robes.
